coverage: CPython audit events and subprocess.Popen recursion; script, -c and -m. stdin/stdout/stderr, cwd, Windows creationflags/startupinfo/job ownership are preserved.
limitations: Not an operating-system sandbox. Direct C/C++ file I/O and Windows DLL loading are outside CPython audit coverage.
File descriptor reads use descriptors opened before or under this policy; the hook cannot infer an inherited descriptor origin.
stat/exists metadata lookups are not content reads and do not all emit CPython audit events.
